01

Maybe this sounds familiar

You're usually the one everyone else leans on. Asking for help can feel like weakness, and what you're carrying can seem too particular for anyone to understand. It isn't. Here is what people most often bring to me:

Anxiety

Constant worry, second-guessing, and a mind that won't switch off.

Troubling memories

Experiences that still feel present years later.

Trauma & painful experiences

Including difficult relationships and family patterns.

Life transitions

Burnout, change, and moments when the old way stops working.

02

About me

I'm Lida Bates, a licensed clinical social worker (LCSW-C) with more than 20 years of experience as a psychotherapist. Before becoming a therapist, I trained as a physician, with residency training in preventive and internal medicine. That background helps me understand how body and mind shape each other, and how to navigate the healthcare system when you need to.

Therapy with me is gentle and direct at once. I'm warm and present, and I won't just nod along: I'll offer honest insight and push back when it helps. I don't pathologize. Much of what you feel makes more sense than you think.

Clients say they leave feeling lighter and truly seen. The words they use most: warm, direct, insightful.
03

How it starts

Three simple steps. No forms before we've talked, and nothing to prepare.

Step 1

A free 15-minute call

You tell me what's going on, in whatever words you have. I'll tell you honestly whether I'm the right fit.

Step 2

A first session

We meet online for 50 minutes. We talk about your history, what you want to change, and how we'll work.

Step 3

Weekly, then at your pace

Most people start weekly. We review progress together and adjust as things shift.

04

EMDR therapy

EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing) is a well-researched therapy for trauma, painful memories and anxiety. It helps a memory lose its emotional charge, so it becomes something that happened rather than something you keep reliving.

You don't need to describe every detail of what happened.

Using guided bilateral stimulation, such as eye movements or tapping, your brain reprocesses the memory at its own pace while I stay with you. I'm EMDR-certified, and it works well online.

Phase 1

Getting to know you

We talk about your history, your goals, and what you want to feel different.

Phase 2

Building resources

You learn ways to feel calm and grounded before we touch anything difficult.

Phase 3

Reprocessing

We work through target memories with bilateral stimulation, one at a time.

Phase 4

Integrating

We check what has shifted and strengthen new, healthier beliefs about yourself.

Fees & FAQ

$150per session
  • Private pay. I don't take insurance, so your care stays between us.
  • Receipts (superbills) for out-of-network reimbursement.
  • A limited sliding scale is available. Ask if you may be eligible.
  • Card, HSA, Venmo, Zelle, check or cash.
Why don't you take insurance?

Insurance requires a diagnosis and can limit how long and how we work. Private pay keeps your records private and lets us focus on what you actually need. Many plans reimburse part of the fee out of network; I'm happy to give you the paperwork.

What happens in the free consultation?

A 15-minute phone call to talk about what's bringing you in and see whether we're a good fit. No pressure, and no need to have the right words ready.

Do you only see clients online?

Yes. Sessions are held by secure video, so you can meet from home, your office, or a parked car at lunch. (It happens more than you'd think.)

How long does EMDR take?

It depends on what we're working on. Some people notice a shift within a few sessions; more complex histories take longer. We'll review progress together along the way.

Do I need to live in Maryland?

Yes. I'm licensed in Maryland, so you need to be physically in Maryland during our sessions. If you're elsewhere, I'm happy to point you toward someone good.

Is online therapy right for everyone?

Individual online therapy works best for adults who are safe and stable day to day. If you're in crisis or need a higher level of care, I'll help you find the right support.
